text.zh_CN: 学年的喧嚣渐渐散去，交易大厅熄灭了聚光灯。档案室将你在远望学院的全部轨迹归档。这里没有完美的预测，只有你愿意承担的代价与信念。
text.en: The academic year's clamor fades; spotlights dim across the trading floor. The archives record your complete trajectory at Farview. There are no perfect forecasts here — only the costs you chose to bear and the principles you kept.

text.zh_CN: 档案只记录你走过的路，不替你下判断。
text.en: The archive records the road you took; it does not judge it for you.

text.zh_CN: 档案里留着一份没有署名的风险预警。你当时选择绕开陷阱，而不是证明自己是对的。
text.en: The file holds an unsigned risk warning. You chose to walk around the trap instead of proving yourself right.

text.zh_CN: 保证金警报响起的那晚，你选择先减仓。你放弃了一部分反弹，也拿回了主动权。
text.en: The night the margin alarm rang, you cut exposure first. You gave up part of the rebound and took back control.

text.zh_CN: 利率冲击来临时，你选择先把仓位换成现金。那份克制后来救了你一次。
text.en: When rates shocked the market, you chose to move to cash first. That restraint saved you once.

text.zh_CN: 危机前夜，你选择为组合买保险。它拖慢了净值，也让你在最坏的时刻还有选择。
text.en: On the eve of the crisis, you chose to insure the portfolio. It slowed the NAV and kept your options open at the worst moment.

text.zh_CN: 你更喜欢收租，而不是买彩票。备兑期权让时间站在你这边。
text.en: You preferred collecting rent to buying lottery tickets. Covered calls put time on your side.

text.zh_CN: 你选择把 ETF 放进底仓。它没有让你一夜暴富，但让你在单票暴雷时还能睡着。
text.en: You chose ETFs for the core. They didn't make you rich overnight, but they let you sleep when a single stock blew up.

text.zh_CN: 你选择让那笔股息继续滚动。复利的故事通常很安静。
text.en: You chose to let the dividend compound. Compounding is usually a quiet story.

text.zh_CN: 你选择从现金流开始看公司。你更愿意相信数字，而不是故事。
text.en: You chose to start with cash flow. You preferred numbers to narratives.

text.zh_CN: 第一天收盘时，你真的去核对了权益和现金。纪律从那一天开始。
text.en: At the first close, you actually checked equity and cash. Discipline started that day.

text.zh_CN: 你开始要求自己写下每一笔交易的理由。市场没有因此变简单，但你不再只靠记忆交易。
text.en: You began writing down why you made every trade. The market did not get easier, but you stopped trading from memory alone.

text.zh_CN: 你从价格和成交量开始。你学会的不是预测趋势，而是在趋势失效时及时退出。
text.en: You started with price and volume. What you learned wasn't to predict trends, but to leave when a trend breaks.

text.zh_CN: 你从财报和估值开始。这个选择没有让你跑得最快，但让你走得更远。
text.en: You started with filings and valuation. It didn't make you the fastest, but it took you further.

text.zh_CN: 你做空了那家可疑公司。你赢了这一局，也知道做空的尾部风险永远不会归零。
text.en: You shorted the suspicious company. You won this round, and you know the tail risk of a short never goes to zero.

text.zh_CN: 保证金警报响起时，你选择补钱硬撑。你买到了时间，也把风险留在了桌上。
text.en: When the margin alarm rang, you chose to wire more money. You bought time, and kept the risk on the table.

text.zh_CN: 保证金警报响起时，你选择不补不减。市场后来放过了你，但你知道那不是因为你做对了。
text.en: When the margin alarm rang, you chose neither to add nor to cut. The market let you go, but you know it was not because you were right.

text.zh_CN: 利率冲击来时，你用衍生品对冲了风险。你没有预测对，但你提前准备了。
text.en: When rates shocked the market, you hedged with derivatives. You did not predict it, but you prepared for it.

text.zh_CN: 利率冲击来时，你选择硬扛。你活了下来，但那不是免费的。
text.en: When rates shocked the market, you chose to hold. You survived, but it was not free.

text.zh_CN: 危机前夜，你选择只对冲一半。你没有全躲开，也没有全暴露。
text.en: On the eve of the crisis, you chose to hedge only half. You did not dodge everything, and you were not fully exposed.

text.zh_CN: 危机前夜，你选择不对冲。你赌市场不会崩，后来你知道了代价。
text.en: On the eve of the crisis, you chose no hedge. You bet the market would not break, and later learned the price.

text.zh_CN: 你买过到期日的彩票。它让你心跳加速，也让你明白时间价值从不免费。
text.en: You bought expiry-day lottery tickets. They raised your pulse and taught you that time value is never free.

text.zh_CN: 你把筹码集中在少数公司上。你赌对了故事，也承担了故事破灭的风险。
text.en: You concentrated on a few companies. You bet on their stories, and carried the risk of those stories breaking.

text.zh_CN: 你把股息花掉了。市场没有评判你，但复利少了一次机会。
text.en: You spent the dividend. The market did not judge you, but compounding lost one turn.

text.zh_CN: 你从价格和趋势开始。你学会的不是预测，而是尊重市场的速度。
text.en: You started with price and trend. What you learned was not prediction, but respect for the market's speed.

text.zh_CN: 第一天你没有去核对权益和现金。后来你补上了，但纪律晚了一步。
text.en: On day one, you did not check equity and cash. You caught up later, but discipline arrived one step late.

text.zh_CN: 请检阅你在远望留下的终局航行图：
text.en: Review your final navigational chart at Farview:

text.zh_CN: 【稳健掌舵人】检阅长青基金执掌档案
text.en: [Steadfast Helmsman] Open Evergreen Flagship File

text.zh_CN: 【学院导师】检阅交易学院教职档案
text.en: [Academy Mentor] Open Academy Faculty File

text.zh_CN: 【独立交易员】检阅个人交易档案
text.en: [Independent Trader] Open Personal Trading File

text.zh_CN: 【暂停赎回】检阅危机处置档案
text.en: [Redemption Gate] Open Crisis Response File

text.zh_CN: 【全额兑付】检阅流动性处置档案
text.en: [Full Redemption] Open Liquidity Response File

text.zh_CN: 【逆势加仓】检阅危机反击档案
text.en: [Buy the Dip] Open Crisis Counterattack File

text.zh_CN: 【明星交易员】检阅对冲基金独行档案
text.en: [Star Trader] Open Hedge Fund Maverick File

text.zh_CN: 【风险复盘】检阅交易与风控档案
text.en: [Risk Review] Open Trading & Risk File

text.zh_CN: 五年过去，远望一期已成长为市场上最具声誉的常青价值基金之一。每年中秋，王先生都会寄来一盒自家阳台晒的桂花茶。林岚已退居幕后，将全院席位交托给你。市场风浪依旧，但只要你在舵盘前，所有人都睡得踏实。
text.en: Five years pass. Farview Fund matures into one of the most respected evergreen flagships in the industry. Every autumn, Mr. Wang sends a tin of sweet osmanthus tea from his garden. Lin Lan has stepped back to senior counsel. The seas churn ceaselessly, but with you at the helm, everyone sleeps soundly.

text.zh_CN: 五年过去，远望一期活了下来，但规模再也没有回到最初。王先生再没有寄过桂花茶；有些客户留了下来，有些再也没有回来。你保住了基金，却没有保住那批最初信任你的人。
text.en: Five years pass. Farview Fund survives, but its size never returns to the early peak. Mr. Wang never sends osmanthus tea again; some clients stay, some never come back. You saved the fund, but not the people who first trusted you.

text.zh_CN: 交易大厅的晨光洒在整洁的讲台上。林岚正式卸任，你站在了当年她带你走过的大厅中央，迎接着新一届满怀暴富梦想的年轻学徒。你微笑着递给他们第一张图表：“欢迎来到远望交易学院。今天第一课，我们先学怎么活下来。”
text.en: Morning sunlight streams across the lecture podium. Lin Lan steps down with honors. You stand at the very center of the hall where she first met you, greeting a fresh cohort of dream-filled rookies. You smile and hand them their first chart: 'Welcome to Farview. Lesson one: how to stay alive.'

text.zh_CN: 你的名字高居年度对冲基金收益榜首，资金像潮水一样涌入。顾言成了你的执行搭档，你们在更复杂的衍生品市场里寻找机会。只是每当深夜警报响起，你始终记着老陈那句话：“拿它当主食的人，最后连骨头渣子都不剩。”
text.en: Your name headlines global hedge fund return league tables; capital pours in like a tide. Gu Yan operates as your execution wing, hunting opportunities across complex derivative markets. Yet whenever the midnight alarms ring, you still remember Lao Chen's line: 'Anyone who treats it as a main course ends up with nothing but bones.'

text.zh_CN: 压力测试的复盘报告里，你启动了门槛条款。假设那场情景真的发生，赎回电话会打爆办公室；三个月后市场恢复，留下来的客户拿回本金和一部分收益。你保住了基金的流动性，也失去了一部分客户的信任。你的名字在行业里多了一个注脚：守住了船，也得罪了人。
text.en: In the stress-test review, you triggered the gate. Had the scenario been real, redemption calls would have overwhelmed the office; three months later the market recovers, and clients who stayed get their principal back plus a partial return. You preserved the fund's liquidity and lost part of your clients' trust. Your name carries a footnote in the industry: you saved the ship and made enemies doing it.

text.zh_CN: 你现在没有基金，也没有客户，只有自己的账户和一套已经验证过的规则。几年后，你的交易记录被整理成一份安静的样本：不惊艳，但每年都在。顾言偶尔还会来找你复盘，他不再问收益率，只问你最近有没有违反自己的规则。
text.en: No fund and no clients now — just your own account and a set of rules you have tested. Years later, your trade log reads like a quiet sample: unspectacular, but consistent every year. Gu Yan still drops by to review trades. He no longer asks about returns; he asks whether you broke your own rules.

text.zh_CN: 办公室的灯光熄灭了。空荡荡的房间里只有一台电脑的微光，上面复盘着每一次侥幸、每一次过度杠杆与每一次自欺。苏禾给你倒了一杯温水：“这份档案不是判决书。只要你还愿意复盘，学费就没白交。”你在日志本上写下最后一句话：“市场永远是对的。”
text.en: Office lights are switched off. In the quiet room, a single monitor glows with a post-mortem of every close call, every overleveraged tick, every self-deception. Su He hands you a warm glass of water: 'This file is not a verdict. As long as you are willing to review it, the tuition wasn't wasted.' You pen the final log entry: 'The market is always right.'

text.zh_CN: 【远望校训】交易的第一课不是赚钱，而是承认自己会错。风险控制不是懦弱，而是让下一笔交易还有机会发生。感谢完成《远望：从学徒到掌舵人》。
text.en: [Farview Creed] The first lesson in trading is not winning, but admitting when you are wrong. Risk discipline is not cowardice; it ensures the next trade can happen. Thank you for completing Farview: From Apprentice to Helmsman.

text.zh_CN: 压力测试的复盘报告里，你选择全额兑付。假设那场情景真的发生，你会在最恐慌的一周卖掉流动性最好的资产，把现金一笔笔交到客户手里。基金净值受了伤，但王先生那样的客户拿到了钱。你没有保住规模，却保住了“赎回”这两个字的分量。
text.en: In the stress-test review, you chose full redemption. Had the scenario been real, you would have sold the most liquid assets in the most panicked week and paid clients cash, one by one. The fund's NAV would take a hit, but clients like Mr. Wang would get their money. You did not preserve AUM, but you preserved the weight of the word 'redemption.'

text.zh_CN: 压力测试的复盘报告里，你选择逆势加仓。假设那场情景真的发生，你会在所有人夺路而逃时把备用金推上牌桌。要么封神，要么清盘，没有中间地带。报告最后一页只写了一句话：“这次你赌对了，但不要把幸存者偏差写成方法论。”
text.en: In the stress-test review, you chose to buy the dip. Had the scenario been real, you would have pushed every reserve dollar onto the table while everyone else ran for the exit. Either glory or liquidation—no middle ground. The last page of the report says only: 'You were right this time. Do not turn survivorship bias into a methodology.'
